question: Kummi dance is related to state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kummi is a traditional folk dance form that is widely popular in the state of Tamil Nadu.

 
 
• The dance is usually performed by women during various festivals and social occasions.
 
• It involves rhythmic clapping and is considered one of the oldest forms of village dances in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Participants form circles or lines and dance to folk songs sung by the group.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kummi Variants

 
 
• There are several variants of Kummi dance, including Veera Kummi, which is performed to celebrate valor and bravery.
 
• Another popular variant is Sevai Kummi, performed as a form of worship.
 
 
 
• Role in Tamil Culture
 
 
• Kummi plays a significant role in preserving the cultural heritage of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The dance is often taught to younger generations to ensure its continuity.
